MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : International Postal Service.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 311.1 (28 May 48) CCS, SCAPIN 1900, dated 28 May 1948, subject same as above, as amended.
2. Effective at once, paragraph 4c of subject memorandum is amended by the addition of sub-paragraph (3), reading as follows:
“(3) Papers of legal procedure relating to patent, trade mark, design or utility model applications and registrations and legal proceedings relative to such industrial property rights.”
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.

GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
APO 500
27 May 1949
MEMORANDUM
SUBJECT: Information of General Application Pertaining to Directive Number SCAPIN 1900/11, file AG 311.1 (28 May 48) CCS, this Headquarters, dated 27 July 1949, subject: International Postal Service
1. With reference to subject memorandum, the following is published for the information of all concerned.
2. This SCAPIN is being issued for the purpose of relaxing restrictions on International Mails to permit the mailing of papers of legal procedure relating to patents and trade marks. This relaxation is considered necessary because of the fact that foreign nationals may now obtain patents in Japan and it is anticipated that Japanese Nationals may soon obtain patents in some countries abroad.
A. J. REHE
Major, AGD
Asst Adj Gen
(See reverse for SCAPIN)
